limitations: Synthetic independent textured JPEGs; no camera/RAW/HEIC corpus or photographic content certification.
Simple three-rectangle RGB PSD; no decorative, large layered, text, CMYK or spot-colour template corpus.
Headless backend only; WKWebView/native UI latency, accessibility and customer workflows remain unverified.
Cold means fresh application-owned caches in a new process; OS page caches are not flushed and source generation warms filesystem caches.
Sampled process-tree RSS can miss short peaks and does not include kernel/GPU/shared-memory accounting.
ps CPU percentages are sampled process-lifetime averages, not instantaneous CPU utilization or total energy.
Defined small/typical/large are harness workload labels, not established customer distributions.
Safety ceilings abort a benchmark; they are not production acceptance budgets.
Retained recovery histories are measured here; long-term growth and approved cleanup remain unresolved.
